1.consolidated_definition: Tratamiento de los esclavos para los amos, mi amo, mi suamo, mi amito… difundido por otras partes de la América de nuestra lengua. Fórmula esta que el negro empleaba indistintamente para dirigirse tanto a sus amos como a otras personas blancas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Treatment of slaves by their owners, my master, my suamo, my amito... a formula that was also used in other parts of the Americas where our language is spoken. This term was employed indistinctly by blacks to address both their masters and other white individuals.
